I answered Hollis in a thread on their #central-random message: the ticket is **#88412**. It's the Tansleigh Packaging gatehouse tablet at Door 6 that freezes when scanning the BOL barcode.

I took this from #central-team, which Hollis is a member of. Tobias Rendle raised the ticket there on Jul 2, 2025, and then confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. Ticket numbers are operational facts, so it's fine to share this in the channel.
